## 1. Load + rules first
Read the PIM export and the UGC. Regex flags emails and phone numbers before any AI is involved.

## 2. Claude, then validation
10 items per call, strict JSON. Output is untrusted until validated: bad JSON is retried once, invented SKUs and rewritten quotes are removed.

## 3. Route + outputs
First matching rule wins: reject → customer service → review → needs human match → approved.
